explanation: Compared against OEIS A229969, comment (i), second part (Zhi-Wei Sun): 'each integer n > 2 can be written as x + y + z (x, y, z > 0) with 2*x+1, 2*y+1, 2*z+1 and 2*x*y*z+1 all prime and x among 1, 2, 3.' The Lean statement for n > 2 asserts ∃ x y z > 0 with x+y+z = n, x ∈ {1,2,3}, and 2x+1, 2y+1, 2z+1, 2xyz+1 prime — a literal transcription (no truncated subtraction issues since all expressions use +). Faithful.
